text_block_list.text:
The second Summer Training Camp has begun. 
Fuji Kiseki fires everyone up, wanting to 
enjoy both practice and fun together with 
all of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the battles ahead growing ever more 
fierce, it looks like we can expect even 
further growth...!
